units.source_text: 从少年时代起，我不被他人所理解，这成为我的惟一的自豪，

en.t: Since boyhood, not being understood by others had become my only pride,

units.source_text: 如上所述，我没有遇到企图让别人理解我的一切作为的表现上的冲动。

en.t: and as I have said above, I never encountered the expressive impulse to make others understand everything I did.

units.source_text: 我总是企图使自己不需要任何斟酌就能明晰，

en.t: I was always trying to make myself clear without needing any allowance or consideration,

units.source_text: 这是否来自想理解自己的冲动呢？

en.t: but did this come from an impulse to understand myself?

units.source_text: 因为这种冲动是根据人的本性，成为在自己与他人之间架起的桥梁。

en.t: For such an impulse, grounded in human nature, becomes a bridge built between oneself and others.

units.source_text: 金阁的美所给予我的陶醉，使我的一部分变得不透明。

en.t: The intoxication that the beauty of the Golden Pavilion gave me made part of me opaque.

units.source_text: 这种陶醉从我身上夺走了其他的所有陶醉，

en.t: This intoxication took away from me every other intoxication,

units.source_text: 为了对抗它，我心须另外依靠我的意志，确保我明晰的部分。

en.t: and in order to resist it, I had to rely separately on my will and secure the clear part of myself.

units.source_text: 这样，别人姑且勿论，对我来说，明晰才是我自己，

en.t: Thus, whatever others might think, for me clarity itself was my self,

units.source_text: 反过来就是说，我并不是那种拥有明晰的自己的人。

en.t: or to put it the other way around, I was not the sort of person who possessed a clear self.
